pipelines.name: issue-fix-and-review
pipelines.description: Fetch GitHub issue → Claude proposes fix → push branch + open PR → AI code review.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: multi-agent-collaboration
pipelines.description: Two-agent conversation: architect designs, implementer codes. Demo / template for custom multi-agent flows.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: review-mr
pipelines.description: GitHub PR auto-review: fetch diff → analyze → post markdown review comment via gh. Use mr-review-fix for GitLab MRs.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet Mantis bug → fix → MR pipeline. Input is just bug_id + project + base_branch + three editable prompts (focus / MR body / Teams message). Fetches summary/description/reporter/assignee/etc from Mantis at run time, has Claude propose a minimal fix, opens a GitLab MR via glab, notifies assignee + reporter on Teams.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mr-pre-review
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet GitLab MR pre-review. User provides an MR URL; pipeline fetches MR meta + diff + discussion, runs Claude analysis per user_prompt focus, posts a '🤖 Forge pre-review:' comment, and opens a Forge chat session for the human reviewer to drill into. Copy of mr-pre-review simplified for manual single runs.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mr-review
pipelines.description: Single-shot Fortinet GitLab MR review responder. User provides an MR URL; pipeline reads all comments + diff, triages (act/skip/close/noop) per user_prompt policy, optionally pushes a fixup commit, replies on the MR, and notifies Teams. Copy of mr-review-fix simplified for manual single runs.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mantis-bug-fix-batch
pipelines.display_name: Fortinet · Mantis Bug Fix (batch with for_each)
pipelines.description: Comma-separated list of Mantis bug ids → for each id, runs the full 10-node fortinet-mantis-bug-fix flow (resolve → fix → MR → notify). One pipeline run, N iterations visible in same UI, no child dispatches. Single id behaves identically to single-bug pipeline.
pipelines.author: forge

pipelines.name: fortinet-mr-review-batch
pipelines.description: Batch the full fortinet-mr-review flow (ingest → triage → fix → reply → cleanup) over N MRs via framework for_each + before. Two input modes: explicit mr_iids CSV, OR author/labels/limit filter resolved at run time by a setup node. Replaces v0.2.0 (iid-only) and v0.1.x (HTTP child-dispatch).
pipelines.author: forge
